text:
The response flags real problems. The GST issue is ranked first and hedged appropriately, since Australian prices are usually GST-inclusive and adding GST on top would overcharge. The mutating `sort`, missing input validation, client-side trust at checkout, and the `formatAud` negative and grouping problems are all genuine and come with concrete fixes. The case-sensitive discount matching is also valid. The ranking is sensible, with the money-affecting issues first and the formatting issue last. Minor gaps: it doesn't mention that the discount is computed on a GST-inclusive or exclusive base, and it doesn't note that `Math.round` per-line rounding can drift from line-item totals. It also stays within the word limit without padding.

Score: 8
